prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce a NEW REVIEW CANDIDATE, not a game-scene screenshot.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 CaptainCabinAtlas is the EDIT TARGET defining exactly six props, their broad palette, view, relative size and 3-column 2-row layout. Images 2 and 3 PainterlyHarborStyle and PainterlyMaritimeStyle are POSITIVE RENDERING STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow their restrained material treatment, not their objects, composition, perspective or alpha defects.
Regenerate the six isolated captain-cabin sprites on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas: top row navigation desk with existing paper/compass/quill/inkwell, single bed with ivory pillow and navy cover, wood sea chest with brass fittings. Bottom row rectangular wood plank floor panel, horizontal straight wooden partition module, navy upholstered wooden chair. No Human/character parts, no new objects.
KEY CORRECTION: thin, consistent-width single dark contours, approximately 1-2px at this canvas size, rather than chunky irregular black rims. Eliminate doubled outlines, bevel-outline sandwiches, colored bleed and glowing edge fringes. Simplify object silhouettes and reduce exaggerated corners, large bedpost caps, chunky legs and excessively thick furniture frames. Keep the established near-top-down view but substantially reduce exposed side faces, extruded depth and deep shadows. Bed and chair should look like practical slim wooden construction, not bulky toy furniture. Partition is a flush-ended repeatable straight module without terminal posts, native proportions preserved.
RETAIN: directional wood grain, subtle warm/cool timber variation and selective knots, fine matte cloth texture and restrained folds, brass fitting color variation and small localized metal highlights, naturally painted material surface shading. Simplified shape does NOT mean simplified material fill. Aim for restrained Stylized Hand-Painted 2D GAME ASSETS, not clean vector illustration, plastic/chibi rendering, glossy beveled icons or photorealistic texture.
Keep surface texture readable and selective, not a dense uniform grain/noise overlay. Reduce dark crease bands and edge distress; avoid rounded inflated geometry. Keep coherent gentle lighting and existing colors. All six items fully inside canvas with generous transparent separation and no overlap. Each within its own 512x512 conceptual cell. True transparent background with clean alpha; no colored atmosphere, brown backdrop, checkerboard, cast shadows outside objects, labels, borders, watermark or comparison text. Do not copy any boat/building/weapon/flag content from references. This is a six-prop review sheet ONLY.
technical_validation: Not imported or sliced. No Unity preview or gameplay validation. Alpha samples are limited metadata checks, not full halo/edge certification.
